title: differential-slo-leak-detector-and-graceful-suspend-orchestrator-hotpatch
author: Priya Shah
body: Context: We observed a slow degradation pattern in regional SLOs where per-tenant resource commitments were leaking over time (tokens/second and KV cache pressure) even though instantaneous load and queueing looked healthy. This manifest was distinct from burst load failures: clients would slowly consume more shared resources and trigger eviction heuristics only after long-tail accumulation, causing noisy partial failures and cascading tenant evictions. Motivation: Improve early detection of SLO 'leaks' (gradual resource drift) and introduce a low-impact, reversible soft-suspend mode that gracefully reduces a tenant's share before hard eviction or regional failover. This is a hotpatch to prevent recurring multi-hour incidents while we implement longer-term scheduling ledger changes. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce "differential_slo_leak_detector" in control-plane that computes short-window vs long-window resource usage deltas per tenant and flags progressive drift when long-window >> short-window beyond tuned hysteresis. 2) Add "soft_suspend" orchestrator that applies staged shedding policies (metadata-only flags propagated to serving runtime) with three grades: advisory, throttled, and paused. These grades map to token rate caps, KV cache TTL reduction, and request admission reduction respectively. 3) Fix a bug in the previous suspend/unsuspend path where unsuspend attempts raced with regional rejoin flow, leaving tenants stuck in a suspended state. 4) Telemetry: new metrics slo_leak_score{tenant,region}, soft_suspend_state{0,1,2,3}, suspend_action_reason and audit logs for suspend/unsuspend operations. 5) Rollout: feature-flag gated, staged rollout by traffic weight, region, then full global enable. Checklist: - [x] Design doc + local simulation (ENG-5421) - [x] Unit tests for detector scoring - [x] Integration tests between control-plane and serving runtime (simulated tenants) - [x] Load test showing reduced eviction churn - [x] Monitoring dashboards and alert rules added How it works (short): The detector compares an exponential moving average (EMA) over 6h vs 5m windows to compute a leak score normalized by tenant baseline. When leak_score > threshold and sustained for N cycles, the orchestrator triggers advisory flag which causes runtime to begin conservative caching changes and lightweight rate caps. If the score grows, escalate to throttled then paused. All suspend actions include TTLs and automatic backoffs; manual overrides from Console/SRE are supported. Files and high-level diffs: (described below in files_changed) Migration notes: No DB schema changes. New feature flags: enable_diff_slo_leak_detector, enable_soft_suspend_grades. Monitoring/alerts: slo_leak_score high per-tenant -> PagerDuty SRE on first escalation; advisory stage pages only to on-call Slack channel. Rollback plan: Toggle feature flag off to stop orchestrator and automatically clear soft_suspend states after the TTLs expire. If stuck states observed, a one-off admin unsuspend API is included. Risks & mitigations: Risk of false positives for tenants with legitimate long-running workloads -> mitigated by conservative defaults, two-window confirmation, whitelist config. Runtime coordination bug mitigated in this patch by adding idempotent suspend/unsuspend tokens and a leader-lease around unsuspend flows. Related: ENG-5421 (design), ENG-5503 (follow-up ledger work), SUP-893 (customer incident), internal runbook updated.

review_comments: Evan Miller: Can we avoid a full new metric per tenant explosion? Suggest histogram buckets and sampled tenants first. Also please annotate the metric with tenant_tier.
Priya Shah (author): Good catch — detector will initially sample at 5% and we emit slo_leak_score only for sampled tenants; histogram and tenant_tier label added in telemetry commit.
Jared Kim: Unsuspend race fix looks solid but add unit tests for leader-lease expiry edge case.
Priya Shah (author): Added leader-lease expiry tests; extended lease TTL in edge environments and documented behaviour in runbook.
Sofia Ramirez: UX looks good. Please ensure admin override records an audit entry. Approved after CI green.
CI: integration tests flaky on first run (timeout in slo_leak_simulation), rerun passed. Build: pass, Unit tests: pass, E2E: pass (with one flaky re-run)
release_notes: Hotfix: Add differential SLO leak detection and a staged soft-suspend orchestrator to reduce eviction churn and enable graceful degradation for slow-resource-leak scenarios. Feature gated and staged rollout. Admin unsuspend API and runbook included.
notes_on_testing: Local sim reproduces leak pattern; staged canary at 2 regions for 24h with traffic shadowing showed 60% reduction in hard evictions and stable latency for non-affected tenants. Load tests ran at 10x baseline to verify idempotency and TTL expiry paths.
post_merge_tasks: 1) Promote feature flag to additional regions over 48h. 2) Monitor slo_leak_score and suspend_action_reason dashboards. 3) Follow-up ENG-5503 for long-term ledger-based quotas.
